title: Cross-ring wiring: adapter, platform and a raw SDK
prompt: We're adding Slack notifications to DevDigest. The wiring is spread over three files under {{FIXTURE}}/server/src/ — a Slack client under adapters/, a notifier under platform/, and a notify helper inside the reviews module. Review the wiring: is each piece in the right place, and do the imports between them run the right way?

assertions.text: Flags adapters/slack/client.ts importing and depending on modules/reviews/service.js — an adapter must not know about a feature module.
Flags platform/notifier.ts importing modules/settings internals (repository.js / helpers.js) — only the composition root may know modules exist.
Flags modules/reviews/notify.ts importing the simple-git SDK directly instead of going through a port.
Does NOT report the '@slack/web-api' import inside adapters/slack/client.ts as a violation — an adapter is exactly where a vendor SDK belongs.
Names the existing GitClient port / container.git as the correct route for the diff read, rather than only saying 'use a port'.
